response.sql: WITH counts_by_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS trade_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS total_count, AVG(trade_count::numeric) AS average_count FROM counts_by_type) SELECT SUM(c.trade_count) AS combined_count, AVG(c.trade_count::numeric / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.trade_count::numeric - totals.average_count) AS average_amount_above_average FROM counts_by_type c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.trade_count > totals.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct trade record is counted once per trader type, even if it has multiple advanced behaviour records. The average is across trader types represented among analysed trades.
